summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K containing Notices of Reliance under Section 13.4 of Canadian National Instrument 51-102 for its subsidiaries, South Bow USA Infrastructure Holdings LLC and South Bow Canadian Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. The filing includes unaudited consolidating summary financial information for the six months ended June 30, 2026, with South Bow guaranteeing the notes issued by its wholly-owned subsidiary. This is a routine continuous disclosure compliance filing with no special-situation transaction involved. No deal terms, acquisitions, divestitures, or corporate actions are present; it is purely a regulatory disclosure requirement for credit support issuers.
